Extract SQL queries for all OMOP-ES plugins

Source: R/omop-es-mappers.R
omop_es_plugins_extract_sql.Rd

For every plug-in in the supplied OMOP-ES directory (omop_es_path), this function runs the plugin on the supplied cohort, but overrides the relevant R functions that query the database (collect() and dbGetQuery()) so that we can extract the SQL queries that the plug-in uses.

Usage

omop_es_plugins_extract_sql(
  omop_es_path,
  settings_id = "CUH_EPIC_small_cohort",
  cohort_limit = 10
)

Arguments

omop_es_path

Path to OMOP-ES directory

settings_id

The OMOP-ES settings to use

cohort_limit

The max number of patients to use. This needs to be small enough to be fast, but large enough to avoid odd quirks (e.g. none of the included patients have an imaging results)

Value

A named nested list of character SQL queries. The outer named list contains one element for each OMOP table. Within each table-level element, there is a named list containing one element per plugin.

Details

This is a way of documenting what OMOP-ES actually asks the source database for, without having to modify OMOP-ES itself.

The OMOP-ES environment is set up exactly as it would be for a pipeline run: setup_environment.R is sourced, the source database connections are opened, the cohort is built and downsampled to cohort_limit patients, and mapping/framework/map_omop.R is sourced to define the omop_plugins object. The plugins are then run by plugins_extract_sql(). The database connections are closed when this function returns.

A small cohort_limit keeps this fast, but it must be large enough that every plugin has some data to work with, since a plugin that short-circuits on an empty input will not issue the queries we are trying to capture.

See also

omop_es_plugins_extract_tables() for the source tables rather than the queries.

Other OMOP-ES plugin introspection: check_type(), enabled_by_settings(), omop_es_plugins_extract_docs_private(), omop_es_plugins_extract_docs_public(), omop_es_plugins_extract_tables(), plugin_extract_sql(), plugin_extract_tables(), plugins_extract_sql(), plugins_extract_tables(), read_table_level_md(), read_table_level_private_md()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
queries <- omop_es_plugins_extract_sql("~/omop_es")
queries$condition_occurrence
} # }
